summary: Melorae was a female Nomai biologist from the Vessel who landed on Ember Twin with Escape Pod 2. She co-founded the Sunless City, mentored Coleus, observed the Quantum Moon, and was the first to propose the Sixth Location hypothesis.

behavior: Melorae was an admirer of the Quantum Moon.
Melorae believed it's never too early to appreciate biology.
location: Melorae landed on Ember Twin with Escape Pod 2.
Melorae lived in the Sunless City on Ember Twin.
Melorae died at some unknown point before the Ash Twin Project began.
lore: Melorae noticed Ember Twin's underground temperatures were more bearable than the surface and recommended building shelter in the cave system.
Melorae and Coleus discovered the cavern where the Sunless City would be built.
Melorae and Coleus studied the Anglerfish fossil in the Sunless City.
Melorae's analysis concluded the Anglerfish fossil died of starvation and was the same species as the Dark Bramble Anglerfish.
Melorae and Coleus concluded the Anglerfish fossil did not originate from Ember Twin.
Melorae was delighted that the children incorporated her Anglerfish-blindness research into their game.
Melorae first observed the Quantum Moon orbiting Dark Bramble, expanding the locator's confirmed positions from four to five.
Melorae proposed a Sixth Location hypothesis when Bur noted the locator sometimes could not find the Quantum Moon.
Melorae and Coleus studied the wandering Cave Shard in the Lakebed Cave.
Melorae was taking notes when her lantern died and Coleus vanished with the Cave Shard.
Melorae became deeply worried about Coleus's limited oxygen supply during his disappearance.
Nomai from the Sunless City joined Melorae to search for Coleus.
Melorae made Coleus promise never to vanish again, even if he learned something useful.
Melorae told Coleus about a subterranean species their clan once encountered while traveling across the universe.
Coleus thought Melorae would have enjoyed meeting the Hearthian ancestors on Timber Hearth.
